about.title: I have always loved tech
about.para1: I was born in Spain, where I earned two official diplomas — in web application development and in multiplatform application development. While studying, I worked part-time as a web developer, and an internship later brought me to Kraków.
about.para2: I am now established in Poland and work as a full-stack developer, focused on modern web technologies and steady growth. I care about clean interfaces, maintainable code and products that are genuinely useful.
about.diploma1Body: Design, development and maintenance of web applications — frontend, backend and databases.
about.diploma2Body: Development of desktop, mobile and multiplatform applications, from design to deployment.
about.krakowBody: After an internship I relocated to Kraków, Poland — and stayed. I work here on site and collaborate remotely across Europe.
about.ctaBody: The fastest way to reach me is email.
